verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles is a first-party identity-resolution feature. Entities and their attributes are declared in version-controlled YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL that performs identity resolution and builds identity graphs from any combination of unique identifiers across sources into a customer 360. That covers configurable, warehouse-native stitching, but the evidence never explicitly addresses anonymous-to-known merging, cross-device stitching, or the specific merge rules. Missing for 10: explicit anonymous-to-known ID stitching docs, cross-device stitching evidence, detailed documentation of configurable merge/resolution rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, anonymous and known activity stitches into one customer profile across devices, with documented and configurable identity-resolution rules

citations.quote: you declare entities and their attributes in version-controlled YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL that handles identity resolution, incremental computation, and feature aggregation automatically.
Seamlessly generate identity graphs from any combination of unique identifiers across any number data sources.
Resolve identities and build a customer 360 in your warehouse.
